description: Set GPS coordinates for the dive site of Dive #2 (December 4, 2010, the first dive at Sund Rock, Hoodsport, WA). Click on the dive to select it, then edit the location's GPS coordinates to: Latitude 47.4005 N, Longitude 123.1420 W (i.e., enter '47.4005 -123.1420' or equivalent). Save the changes.
